Bengaluru citizens protest stadium and tunnel road projects

Thousands of Bengaluru citizens protested against two proposed infrastructure projects: an 80,000-seat stadium and a tunnel road. Conservationists and citizens rallied under the banner 'Save Lalbagh' to oppose these developments. The protests highlight concerns over the potential impact on green spaces and public parks in the city.
